mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) signals robust manufacturing expansion that boosts corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during expansionary cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO > 105 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals potential monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls and rising unemployment rate indicates severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint deterioration in PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during growth regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of GDPC1 > 3.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity that boosts corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO rising periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
